name: spot-tier-variant
description: Y.60d: per-spot tier/variant logic. When a spot is outnumbered by >=100 vs nearest enemy, tier 2+ should ShieldWall; when outnumbered by >=200, tier 3+ should Circle; when outnumbering by >=50 on a flank role, cav should Charge. (Note: this scenario currently feeds the SAME Y.54+Y.56 rule logic the sim already covers; once Y.60d ships its own pure-method extraction, we'll add direct rule scenarios. For now, validates that broken-retreat fires when units<25 + retreatW>3 on shield-wall spots.)
